topic.name: Benefits of using a Local Area Network (LAN)

subtopics.name: Benefits of using a Local Area Network (LAN)

parts.problem_md:
The concert venue uses an online booking system.

Gail uses different types of networks in her job.

(ii)

Define the term ‘peer‑to‑peer’.

[1]

(v)

Describe how a roaming profile allows Gail to hotdesk.

[2]
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> (ii)
> 
> Any one from:
> 
> - Each device can share its own resources and request resources from the other devices in the network.
> - A network model that means computers do not rely on servers to provide shared resources.
> - Data is stored locally on the networked devices.
> 
> (v)
> 
> A description to include two from:
> 
> - The user’s (profile) data is downloaded from a server (1) and stored on each machine (1) after they log on (1)
> - The user’s data is synchronised (1) with the server / during log on/off (1)

parts.problem_md:
Joe connects to different types of networks.

Describe** one **role of a server in a client-server network.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> - To provide a (central) store of data/applications (1) and handle requests by clients (1)
> - To provide access to (shared) printers (1) and manage/queue client requests (1)
> - To manage security (1) by providing user authentication / access controls (1)
> - To manage updates/maintenance (1) deployed to all clients (1)
> - Provides centralised backup (1) so that each device does not have to be backed up individually (1)
> 
> Award responses that describe central, security, email services etc.

parts.problem_md: Explain **one** benefit of using a client-server network rather than a peer‑peer network.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation such as:
> 
> - Better security (1) because of control of user access rights (1)
> - Less chance of data loss (1) because backup is centralised (1)
> - Reduced admin/maintenance (1) because software/storage can be shared (1)
> - Allow flexible use of space / hotdesking (1) because roaming profiles can be set up (1)
> - You don’t need to back up each computer individually (1) because backups can be centralised (1)
